attr.title: Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit 2
attr.desc: Race exotic cars and outrun the police in a native port of the PS2 version of Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit 2, adapted from the New 3DS port. Play Hot Pursuit, Championship, Ultimate Racer and You're The Cop with the original single-screen HUD.
attr.inst: Copy an .iso of your PAL (SLES-50731) or NTSC (SLUS-20362) PS2 disc into ports/nfshp2/gamedata/; the first launch installs the game from it (about 10 minutes, 3 GB free, python3 needed, or see the README to install from a computer).
